trial_backend.description: Probe Tailscale CLI availability without changing tailnet or serve state.

install_backend.description: Install the Tailscale macOS app through Homebrew, then enable its CLI (Settings > Install CLI) and log in.

linux.description: Linux hosts install Tailscale from the upstream package repository (https://tailscale.com/download/linux), then run `sudo tailscale up`.

tools.notes: Runtime for the public-ingress provider `tailscale-funnel`. Override the binary with KYBERION_TAILSCALE_BIN (for example /Applications/Tailscale.app/Contents/MacOS/Tailscale when the app's CLI is not on PATH).
